page_title: BUR 0-2 LIV | Burnley v Liverpool 26/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) hammers the ball towards the roof of the net, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Alisson, who denies him with a terrific save.
90+1' Today's referee Paul Tierney rightly decides to book Dara O'Shea (Burnley) for his harsh tackle.
90+1' Josh Brownhill will be replaced by Aaron Ramsey (Burnley).
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 2 Goal - 0:2! Luis Diaz tees up Diogo Jota (Liverpool) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past James Trafford.
90' The corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is intercepted by the defence.

88' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. James Trafford guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
88' Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) tries his luck and hits a thunderbolt of a shot towards goal from long range, but his powerful strike goes narrowly wide of the left post.
85' Substitution. Zeki Amdouni walks off the pitch and Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) comes on as a substitute.
85' Here is a change. Lyle Foster is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Redmond (Burnley).
84' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Darwin Nunez.
83' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but it lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
80' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
79' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) takes a shot from the edge of the area, but it goes harmlessly wide of the right post.
78' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
77' Paul Tierney shows a yellow card to Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) for a tough tackle.
77' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
76' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
73' The Liverpool players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
70' Charlie Taylor (Burnley) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
70' Corner kick. Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) is ready to send the ball into the box.
68' A cross is whipped into the centre of the box towards Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley). He gets a good contact on the ball but heads it high over the bar.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Harvey Elliott as he is replaced by Luis Diaz (Liverpool).
67' Jurgen Klopp has decided to make a change. Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) replaces Cody Gakpo.
66' A substitution has been made. Ryan Gravenberch is replaced by Curtis Jones (Liverpool).
65' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is flagged for offside.
63' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) makes a strong challenge and Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
61' Vincent Kompany has decided to substitute Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye and he is replaced by Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley).
60' Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
60' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Dara O'Shea (Burnley), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar.
60' Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) prepares to take a corner kick.
59' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
57' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Liverpool players look gutted.
56' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Liverpool players aren’t happy.

55' Ryan Gravenberch is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot which bounces in off the bottom of the right post to make the score 0:2.
54' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
54' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
51' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
48' Jarell Quansah (Liverpool) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Paul Tierney no option but to blow his whistle. Burnley get a free kick.
46' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' James Trafford pulls off a great save to deny Mohamed Salah (Liverpool), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
42' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
42' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Joe Gomez (Liverpool), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
41' There's an opportunity for Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

40' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom left corner, but James Trafford has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. Liverpool force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
38' A cross from Joe Gomez (Liverpool) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
36' Vitinho (Burnley) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.

34' OFF THE CROSSBAR! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
31' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
29' Goal! No, wait. It's disallowed for a foul by Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
27' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
24' Paul Tierney blows for a foul after Josh Brownhill (Burnley) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Liverpool win a free kick.
23' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but James Trafford comes off his line to gather the ball.
23' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
22' Sander Berge (Burnley) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Paul Tierney ignores the protests.
21' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
19' Lyle Foster (Burnley) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
15' Mike Tresor Ndayishimiye (Burnley) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
12' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
10' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes well past the left post.
9' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
9' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

8' Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) drives a shot towards the roof of the net from inside the box, but James Trafford leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
6' 0 - 1 Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) doesn't hesitate to lash home from just outside the box. He hits the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and it nestles in the net.
5' Zeki Amdouni (Burnley) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
5' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
5' Flag goes up against Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
4' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Burnley will have the kick-off.
Paul Tierney will officiate today.
